newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hoechst board members take on new tasks.
newsitem.headline: Hoechst board members take on new tasks.

text.p: Germany's Hoechst AG said on Friday that it had slightly reshuffled the responsibilities of its management board members with four taking on additional activities.
In a statement, Hoechst, the world's largest chemicals group, said that board chairman Juergen Dormann would also be responsible for corporate executive development.
Chief financial officer Klaus-Juergen Schmieder will also be in charge of corporate controlling and corporate auditing.
Horst Waesche, the board member in charge of the pharmaceuticals, will now also be in charge of Behring Diagnostics, Centeon, and Chrion Behring.
Claudio Sonder, the board member in charge of the AgrEvo crop protection unit will now also be responsible for the newly founded unit Nutrition Specialties GmbH.
